proven_claims: pointsScale lives at tidx(139), the first of three otherwise-unclaimed 'funnel-link'-shaped 30-member blocks pt.3's investigation left undecoded (tidx(140)/tidx(141) are hypothesized, unproven, to be valuesScale/seriesScale by the same pattern).

The block's shared prefix `2,0,0,2,{1,0}` plus a 13-member titleArea tuple (font/textColor/backColor/border/borderColor, form_chart_scale_title_area_xml) are present and default-valued even in the chart-form-4series control, where pointsScale itself is absent from the XML -- so titleArea's own encoding does not gate the element's presence.
A tri-state slot right after titleArea: "2"=pointsScale absent (22 sub-fields total), "1"=gridLinesShowMode DontShow, "0"=Show (23 sub-fields, since a gridLine record is inserted only when present).
gridLine reuses form_chart_line_xml's shape, extended here with a second style code: "1"=Solid (already known) and "2"=Dotted (new, single observation from the full seed).

labelColor is its own conditionally-written slot right after gridLine, using the shared form_chart_color auto/direct-RGB pattern: auto is omitted from the XML entirely (not written as the literal text 'auto', unlike every other colour field decoded so far), direct RGB is written -- isolated from gridLinesShowMode/gridLine by comparing minimal (labelColor omitted) against label-color-only (labelColor=#B4B4B4, otherwise identical raw record).

Only two gridLine style codes are proven (1=Solid, 2=Dotted); a second observation of Dotted (a different width/context) has not been taken.
